systems.system: Interconnection of the fibre-optic networks of Gabon and Equatorial Guinea
systems.owner: the two states, under an agreement approved by Gabon's Council of Ministers on 18 December 2025
systems.tiers: national networks; no local government office named

note: A communiqué of Gabon's Council of Ministers. Its passage on bringing collectivités locales into digitalisation concerns Gabon; for Equatorial Guinea it states only three bilateral telecommunications agreements, on roaming, border interference and fibre interconnection.
